cards.title: Why not read the index
items: docs/ is the public manual and also where this repository's conventions put notes that are never committed, so reading the folder published a maintainer's notes and failed the suite in their checkout
Reading the index instead meant parsing markdown links, and three review rounds each found another valid shape that dropped a page in silence

cards.title: Both ways of going wrong are loud
items: A page named here with no file stops the build, naming it
A committed page in docs/ that nobody named fails the suite, which was checked by committing one and not naming it
